explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/311: δ(N) = e^{-(c+o(1))N} for some c ∈ (0,1), encoded as -log δ(N)/N → c. δ(N) is the minimal nonzero |1 - Σ_{n∈A} 1/n| over A ⊆ [1,N], over a finite set of values, so the sInf is a genuine minimum. Dropping the [ErGr80] side condition is justified by Kovač's equivalence, as the docstring notes. Correctly marked open.
